{{MissingInfo|1|enva}} [[File:Rock hunters.png|thumb|250px|Rock hunters]] The '''rock hunters''' (Japanese: '''岩石ハンター''' ''rock hunters'') are a group of [[Character of the day|characters of the day]] that appeared in ''[[SM095|Sparking Confusion!]]''. They appeared on [[Akala Island]] at [[Wela Volcano Park]], where they were hunting for Spark Stones, in the process disrupting the feeding rituals of the {{rf|Alolan}} {{p|Geodude}} and {{p|Graveler}} living there. After one of them lost a battle to [[Kiawe's Marowak]], they went inside a nearby cave. They were attacked while inside, but ended up being found by {{Ash}}, Kiawe, and {{an|Sophocles}} after Kiawe suggested they should see what the hunters were up to. The hunters told them that they were attacked while mining for more Spark Stones. When they saw the assailant, an Alolan {{p|Golem}}, they ran away. ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|2|java|enva|scope=section}} {{TrainerPoké |pkmn=Pinsir |trainer=Rock Hunters |type1=Bug |img=Rock hunters Pinsir.png |epnum=SM095 |epname=Sparking Confusion! |vaen= |vajp= |desc={{p|Pinsir}} is the rock hunters' only known Pokémon. It was briefly sent out to battle the [[Ultra Guardians]], only to be defeated by [[Kiawe's Marowak]].
